description: This file implements a media engine plugin for the WPEFramework, providing media playback control, event handling, and configuration via JSON-RPC. It manages media player instances, handles initialization, playback, volume, mute, and video rectangle settings, and communicates status and error events.

classes.name: MediaEngineRMF
classes.description: A plugin class implementing media playback functionalities, event handling, and JSON-RPC method registration for the MediaEngineRMF plugin.

methods.name: initialize_player
methods.description: Initializes the media player with a specified source type, currently supporting 'qam'. Sets environment variables and updates the player state.

methods.name: deinitialize_player
methods.description: Deinitializes the media player for the 'qam' source type, updating the player state.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Creates and starts media playback for a specified source, supporting 'ocap' identifiers.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops media playback and resets the player instance.

methods.name: mute
methods.description: Sets the mute state of the media player.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Adjusts the volume of the media player.

methods.name: setVideoRectangle
methods.description: Sets the video display rectangle parameters.

methods.name: onEvent
methods.description: Handles media events and sends notifications.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles error events and sends notifications.
